`https://three.arcprize.org/api/games/<game_id>/source` with an anonymous key from
`/api/games/anonkey`. Each file carries an in-file MIT licence header,
Copyright (c) 2026 ARC Prize Foundation, identical to the one documented in
`../ls20/PROVENANCE.md`; the same licence caveats apply. `games.json` is the
API game list (ids, titles, tags, per-level human baseline actions).
